system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: 10 spaces

Area: 5-space-radius

You ward an area against supernatural creatures.

Choose a point within 10 spaces. Until the start of your next turn, every magical creature within a 5-space-radius of that point takes a dice penalty to all checks it makes. The penalty is equal to your Soul, minus the target's Soul, to a minimum of 1.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.

If you spend 10 minutes using this ability, you may make it last 1 day.

If you spend 1 hour using this ability, you may make it last 10 days.

If you spend 1 day using this ability, you may make it last 30 days.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.SwC1yqf0vtq80do8]{Abjuration of the Arbiter}
